name: How much does it typically cost to repair a kitchen faucet in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does it typically cost to repair a kitchen faucet in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a kitchen faucet in Las Vegas can vary significantly depending on the specific issue and the type of faucet. Minor repairs, such as replacing a washer or O-ring, are generally less expensive than issues requiring new cartridge or valve replacement. For an accurate estimate, CG Plumbing Solutions offers transparent pricing after diagnosing the problem, ensuring you understand the repair scope before work begins.
